answer: Light cannot be in two groves at once. Each epoch, forty spiral groves open for twenty minutes: a claimant walks the path while a prism splits a beam into a color seeded by the last block and the key, no color repeats. Entry locks 85 POA, +40 per extra identity from one root: ten linked fakes lock 2,650 POA. Each walk needs three stranger witnesses, two groves each. One operator walks two groves at most, so ten fakes need five hands, ten walks, thirty witnesses at once. A miss burns 20; one color shown twice burns both bonds. Walk times match roots: a farm's ten groves collapse into one.
